historical_numerical_note: France and UK/Ireland reproduce exactly. 48 Canaries darkness values differ by at most 2.7977620220553945e-14; positions, Bortle, countries and naming match. Differences exist in A without WBM. A 350-km ALR kernel was tested and does not reproduce the published values; directory names do not establish kernel parameters. Floating-point/FFT build differences are plausible, but the original build environment was not archived; exact last-bit cause remains unresolved. Absolute comparison tolerance is 1e-12, explicitly reported, not rounded away.

benchmark.note: Empty means application WBM cache, not the operating-system filesystem cache. ALR is not rerun here.

limitations: OSM disagreements require review; no orthophoto or field confirmation.
711 final D points are outside the downloaded inland-extract footprints (678 FR, 33 UK/Ireland). The marine OSM land mask covers all points but is not an inland-water validation.

One new four-to-three coverage deficit at La Roquette-sur-Var: Esparron lake point at 99.695 km is replaced by WBM land at 100.027943 km. The 100-km radius is unchanged; the eligible pool contains three points.
A last-bit numerical mismatch remains for 48 Canaries darkness values; it predates WBM and does not change selection or Bortle.
The final implementation rejects unsupported projected/rotated VIIRS mesh grids explicitly. Projected WBM data are sampled with grouped transformations and unit-tested.

Initial full-simulation timings include concurrent validation work and the earlier scalar cell-envelope calculation. The isolated final benchmark includes production guards and verifies exact selection output equality.
publication: No published data, masks, regional configuration or source data repository modified. All spot/cluster generation was confined to temporary snapshots. Publication decision remains with the user.
